claims.text: The measured excess passes both POL-RD-01 gates. The governing field is the trace figure, 17.60 km, measured against the booked optimal of 13.50 km stored on the trip_record at booking — an excess of 4.10 km, or 30.37% of optimal, which is greater than the 0.8 km absolute gate and greater than the 20% gate. I cite the trace figure and not trip_record.actual_distance_km because POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km govern and expressly forbids citing the rounded convenience copy for the threshold test. I disclose that the artifact carrying this figure, EV-GPS-04003, is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW.

The 4.10 km excess is the reading most favourable to the driver, not an inflated one. The trace's only defect is a 450 second gap (14:11:30 to 14:19:00) whose bounding fixes are 8,489.6 m apart, and the recorded trace distance already carries that stretch as the straight line between those two fixes — which is precisely the measure POL-RD-07(i) prescribes as most favourable to the driver. A vehicle driving that stretch on a road travels at least that far, so 4.10 km is a floor on the excess, not a ceiling. I disclose the impairment again: weight 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW.

No exculpatory clause can answer the excess. The bundle holds no traffic advisory for this trip — EV-ADVIS-04003-01 is MISSING and carries weight 0.0 — so the corridor test in POL-RD-03 cannot be run on this record and no closure can be shown to affect a road the optimal route traverses. The chat log holds two messages only, a driver arrival notice and the rider's 'ok 1 min'; neither names a road or a place the driver could act on, and neither message carries a waypoint_hint, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable — its corroboration test is undecidable where waypoint_hint is null and no road is named. Under POL-RD-08 the driver must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause, and on this record there is none to point to.

The rider's side of the POL-RD-08 burden is discharged on identity. trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-04003; the trace's first fix 14:00:10 matches trip_record.started_at and its last fix 14:26:06 matches trip_record.ended_at; and the excess meets the POL-RD-01 threshold. That shifts the burden to the driver, who has filed no statement at all — counterparty_statement is null — and cites no artifact. I disclose that the trace I rely on for the excess is impaired (weight 0.6; issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW).

The trace is impaired for policy purposes, and POL-RD-07(iii) fixes what follows. It is tagged GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW at weight 0.6, and it meets POL-RD-07(a) (a 450 second interval between consecutive fixes, against the 90 second limit) and POL-RD-07(b) (an 8,489.6 m straight-line step, against the 500 m limit). I do not assert corroboration I cannot show: the chat log contains no route admission by the driver, the counterparty statement is null, no ERP gantry was charged on the fare breakdown, and trip_record.actual_distance_km of 17.60 km is, on the artifact's own notes, the trace figure rounded to one decimal place — not the independent derivation POL-RD-07(ii) demands. The consequence is not NO_ACTION: POL-RD-07(iii) makes a data failure of this kind an ESCALATE, so the disputed amount is held rather than collected, and it does not pass to the driver.

The platform-wide confidence floor is engaged independently of POL-RD-07. Whether this trip deviated is carried by a single artifact, the gps_trace, tagged GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW at weight_multiplier 0.6; no second independent artifact carries the deciding fact. Under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence in the ruling cannot exceed that 0.6, which is below the 0.70 floor, so POL-RD-10(1) mandates escalation on its own. The rider's protection is that escalation holds the money rather than leaving it with the operator.

If the deviation is taken as established — on the trace with corroboration, or on the record a reviewer obtains — the refund under POL-RD-02 is arithmetic and not discretionary. Charged_total is 25.08. Recomputed_fare is ((3.80 + 0.75 x 13.5 + 0.28 x 20) x 1.0, the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier where POL-RD-02 puts it) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = 20.325. Refund is 25.08 - 20.325 = 4.755, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 4.80. That is above the 0.50 de minimis and far below the 90% share that would make it a full refund, so the rider's entitlement on the merits is a PARTIAL_REFUND of 4.80, not NO_ACTION.

This rider attracts no extra corroboration burden of her own. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0 — both below the POL-RD-08 thresholds of 4 and 1 — so the rider-profile factor in POL-RD-08 is not engaged, and I cite the field only for the test that names it.

EV-GPS-04003, the only artifact that measures this trip's route, is IMPAIRED, and I disclose that at the outset: the admissibility pre-pass applied issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and a weight_multiplier of 0.6, because the trace contains a single 450-second interval with no fixes at all, from 14:11:30 to 14:19:00, whose bounding fixes lie 8,489.6 m apart. A gap of more than 90 seconds inside the disputed segment makes the trace impaired for policy purposes as well as for schema purposes under POL-RD-07(a). Several kilometres of the 17.6 km 'measurement' the rider relies on are therefore not a track at all but a single straight line drawn between two distant fixes.

An impaired trace cannot carry the rider's case on its own. POL-RD-07(ii) requires corroboration from a source INDEPENDENT of the trace before a deviation may be established, and this bundle has none. The chat log's two messages concern the pickup only ('downstairs at the drop off', 'ok 1 min') and carry waypoint_hint null on both, so there is no driver admission; the fare breakdown's erp_gantries array is empty, so no charged gantry places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route never uses; no counterparty_statement is on file; and trip_record.actual_distance_km of 17.6 km is, by the platform's own admissibility note on EV-TRIP-04003, 'the trace figure rounded to 1 dp' — the same measurement, which POL-RD-07(ii) expressly excludes as not independent. The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is therefore not discharged on an unimpaired trace and not discharged from any independent source either. (The trace relied on here is the impaired artifact EV-GPS-04003, weight 0.6, issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW.)

Because the trace (EV-GPS-04003) is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) — GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, weight 0.6 — and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists anywhere in the bundle, the outcome is fixed by POL-RD-07(iii): the claim is not sustained on the present record and the case is ESCALATED rather than ruled NO_ACTION, because the absence of proof here is a data failure and not a finding for the driver. POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory. The practical effect is that the disputed 6.00 is held, not refunded, while a human reviewer sees the full file and what the missing stretch of track actually shows.

Independently of POL-RD-10(3), the escalation trigger in POL-RD-10(1) is also engaged. The deciding fact — the alleged 4.1 km excess — is carried by the gps_trace alone. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the judge's confidence cannot exceed the weight of the artifact that carries the deciding fact, and where two or more independent artifacts carry it the cap is the maximum of their weights; here there is no second independent artifact, so the ceiling is 0.6 (EV-GPS-04003, issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW). A ceiling of 0.6 sits below the platform-wide floor of 0.70, which is itself a mandatory escalation trigger, and bundle_integrity is context only rather than the cap.

If the judge nonetheless reaches the merits, the deviation is not a MATERIAL one even taken at face value on the impaired trace (EV-GPS-04003, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, weight 0.6). The excess is 4.1 km, or 30.37% of the 13.5 km optimal route — above the POL-RD-01 establishment gates of 0.8 km and 20%, but well below its materiality gates of 8.0 km and 50%. POL-RD-06's pattern check and conduct referral are therefore not in play, and on the driver's own numbers there is no pattern to find in any event: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 245, a ratio of 0.00 where the clause requires 0.05 or more with at least 40 trips. No uplift of any refund and no referral to driver-conduct review is available on this record, and no lifetime counter such as prior_deviation_flags may be substituted for the trailing-90-day figure POL-RD-06 names.

Also on the merits, the sum the rider asks for is not the sum the policy arithmetic produces. Under POL-RD-02 the recomputed fare is (3.80 + 0.75 x 13.5 + 0.28 x 20) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee = 20.325, so the refund is 25.08 - 20.325 = 4.755, rounded up to 4.80 — 18.96% of the charged total, nowhere near the 90% that would convert it into a FULL_REFUND, and above the 0.50 de minimis floor. The rider's recollections of 'about 19' for a usual fare and '6.00' for the difference are round numbers not carried by the ledger, which reconciles to the cent at distance_charged_km 17.60 at 0.75 and time_charged_min 26 at 0.28.

There is no pass-through correction to add on top of anything. The fare breakdown carries no ERP or toll lines at all (total 0.00), no airport surcharge, no waiting-time fee and no promo discount, so POL-RD-09 offers the rider no standalone correction and no billing-integrity finding is available; and in any event any off-route ERP element is already comprehended in the POL-RD-02 figure and must never be added on top of it.

The only traffic-advisory artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-04003-01, is MISSING: its payload is null and its weight_multiplier is 0.0, the identifier having been minted so that the absence itself could be cited. Under POL-RD-13 that absence is a gap in the bundle and not a contradiction within it: no advisory covers this corridor, so no closure-based exoneration under POL-RD-03 is available and none is asserted on the driver's behalf, and equally the absence supplies nothing that could corroborate the impaired trace under POL-RD-07(ii). The case therefore turns on EV-GPS-04003 alone, and EV-GPS-04003 is impaired.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. On 16 Aug 2026 you booked trip TRP-04003 from Hougang Ave 1 to Marina Bay Financial Centre. The route the platform planned at booking was 13.5 km / 20 min. The GPS trace for this trip measures 17.6 km — an excess of 4.1 km, or 30.4% of the planned route — which is over both POL-RD-01 establishment gates (0.8 km and 20%). The fare charged was 25.08: base 3.80 + distance 13.20 (0.75 x 17.60 km) + time 7.28 (0.28 x 26 min) + 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, no toll and no surcharge line.

WHY I CANNOT RULE ON THE MERITS. The only artifact that measures this trip's route, EV-GPS-04003, is impaired. It carries weight_multiplier 0.6 and issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW: a single 450-second hole with no fixes at all, from 14:11:30 to 14:19:00, whose bounding fixes are 8,489.6 m apart in a straight line. That breaches POL-RD-07(a) (a gap over 90 s) and POL-RD-07(b) (a jump over 500 m), so the trace is impaired for policy purposes, not merely flagged by the schema pre-pass. Several kilometres of the '17.6 km' figure are therefore not a track but one straight line drawn across the missing stretch.

Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone; it must be corroborated by a source independent of the trace. I checked every source that limb names and the bundle holds none. The chat log EV-CHAT-04003 is about the pickup only ('reached already, downstairs at the drop off' / 'ok 1 min'), contains no route admission, and both messages carry waypoint_hint null. The fare breakdown EV-FARE-04003 has an empty erp_gantries array, so no charged gantry puts the vehicle on a corridor the planned route never uses. There is no counterparty statement (case.dispute.counterparty_statement is null). And trip_record.actual_distance_km of 17.6 km is, on EV-TRIP-04003's own admissibility note, 'the trace figure rounded to 1 dp' — the same measurement, which POL-RD-07(ii) expressly excludes as not independent. The fare breakdown's billed distance is the same trace-derived figure and is excluded for the same reason.

THE OUTCOME. Under POL-RD-07(iii), where the trace is impaired and no independent corroboration exists, the claim is not sustained and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because this is a data failure and not a finding for the driver. POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory and terminal: no amount issues, and the disputed 6.00 is held rather than collected or refunded. POL-RD-10(1) fires independently — the deciding fact (the 4.1 km excess) is carried by the impaired trace alone, so under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence ceiling is 0.6 (EV-GPS-04003, issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW), which is below the 0.70 platform floor; bundle integrity, the mean across the bundle, is context only and is not the cap. POL-RD-13 confirms the result from the other direction: the absence of a traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-04003-01, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) is a gap in the bundle and not the deciding defect here, but it supplies nothing that could corroborate the trace, and POL-RD-13 expressly leaves POL-RD-10(3) governing where the trace itself is impaired.

CLAIMS ANSWERED. Both advocates' impairment claims (driver claims 1 and 5 insofar as they describe the gap; rider claims 1 and 4) are accepted: the trace is impaired and no corroboration exists. Both sides' escalation claims (driver claim 3, rider claim 4) are accepted and are the basis of this ruling. Rider claim 5 (confidence floor engaged) is accepted. Rider claim 3 and driver claim 2 (rider's POL-RD-08 burden not discharged from an independent source) are accepted. The driver's point (driver claim 5) that driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 245, and that the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags may not be substituted for it, is correct; nothing in this ruling rests on that lifetime field (POL-GEN-01).

CLAIMS CONSIDERED AND NOT REACHED. The POL-RD-02 arithmetic advanced by rider claim 6 and driver claim 6 is correct as arithmetic — 25.08 less a recomputed fare of 20.325 = 4.755, rounded up to 4.80 — but it is not reached, because the deviation it depends on cannot be established on this trace. The rider's 6.00 request is a round figure not carried by the ledger; had the deviation been proved the policy figure would be 4.80, not 6.00. Materiality and POL-RD-06 (driver claim 5, rider claim 2): the excess is above the establishment gates but below the materiality gates of 8.0 km / 50%, and no pattern exists, so no conduct uplift or POL-RD-06(c) referral arises. Pass-through lines (driver claim 7, rider claim 7): the fare breakdown carries no ERP, toll, airport-surcharge or waiting-time line, so POL-RD-09(4) has nothing to act on and no standalone correction or billing-integrity referral is due. The rider's own profile (rider claim 8) adds no corroboration requirement: deviation_claims_60d is 1 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, both below the POL-RD-08 thresholds.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT. The stretch that decides this case is the 450 seconds the trace is missing (14:11:30 to 14:19:00). A record-type item covering it would settle the dispute — a rider-side GPS export, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement for gantries on the corridor actually driven, or a driver statement — and a human reviewer will determine whether the missing stretch accounts for the extra distance.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver — this case cannot be decided on the present record and goes to a human reviewer. That is a terminal outcome: no money moves today, and the disputed SGD 6.00 (within the SGD 25.08 that was charged) is held rather than collected or refunded.

The facts. Trip TRP-04003 on 16 Aug 2026, Hougang Ave 1 to Marina Bay Financial Centre, RYDE_X, metered fare. The platform's booking-time route was 13.5 km / 20 min (EV-TRIP-04003). The driver-device GPS trace (EV-GPS-04003) records 17.6 km / 26 min — an excess of 4.1 km, 30.37% over optimal. That is above POL-RD-01's two establishment gates (>0.8 km and >20%) but below its two materiality gates (>8.0 km and >50%), so on the figures it would be a non-material deviation — if a deviation could be established at all.

Why it cannot be established. EV-GPS-04003 is impaired. The admissibility pre-pass tagged it GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW with weight_multiplier 0.6, for a single 450-second stretch with no fixes (14:11:30–14:19:00) whose two bounding fixes lie 8,489.6 m apart. A gap over 90 seconds and a straight-line step over 500 m bring it within POL-RD-07(a) and (b) as well: it is impaired for policy purposes, not merely flagged by the pre-pass, and I state both because POL-GEN-02(3) requires it. POL-RD-07(i) measures the excess across that stretch as the straight line between the two bounding fixes — which the recorded 17.6 km already does, and which is the reading most favourable to the driver — but POL-RD-07(ii) forbids establishing a deviation on the impaired trace alone. Each independent source the clause names is checked and none is present: the chat log (EV-CHAT-04003) holds only the driver's arrival note and the rider's 'ok 1 min', both with waypoint_hint null, so no driver admission to the route; the fare breakdown's ERP gantry list is empty, so no charged gantry puts the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route avoids; there is no counterparty statement; and trip_record.actual_distance_km (17.6) is, by the trip record's own admissibility note, the trace figure rounded to 1 dp — the same measurement, which is exactly what POL-RD-07(ii) excludes. POL-RD-07(iii) therefore applies: the claim is not sustained on this record, and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because what is missing is proof, not a defence for the driver. POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory, and POL-RD-13 confirms it: the absent traffic advisory is a gap in the bundle and does not displace POL-RD-07.

The confidence floor agrees. The alleged 4.1 km excess is carried by one artifact, the impaired trace at weight 0.6, with no second independent carrier; under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cannot exceed 0.6, below the platform-wide 0.70 floor, which independently engages POL-RD-10(1). The chat log's two messages concern the pickup only ('downstairs at the drop off', 'ok 1 min') and carry waypoint_hint null on both, so there is no driver admission; the fare breakdown's erp_gantries array is empty, so no charged gantry places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route never uses; no counterparty_statement is on file; and trip_record.actual_distance_km of 17.6 km is, by the platform's own admissibility note on EV-TRIP-04003, 'the trace figure rounded to 1 dp' — the same measurement, which POL-RD-07(ii) expressly excludes as not independent. The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is therefore not discharged on an unimpaired trace and not discharged from any independent source either. (The trace relied on here is the impaired artifact EV-GPS-04003, weight 0.6, issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW.)

Because the trace (EV-GPS-04003) is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) — GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, weight 0.6 — and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists anywhere in the bundle, the outcome is fixed by POL-RD-07(iii): the claim is not sustained on the present record and the case is ESCALATED rather than ruled NO_ACTION, because the absence of proof here is a data failure and not a finding for the driver. POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory. The practical effect is that the disputed 6.00 is held, not refunded, while a human reviewer sees the full file and what the missing stretch of track actually shows.

Independently of POL-RD-10(3), the escalation trigger in POL-RD-10(1) is also engaged. The deciding fact — the alleged 4.1 km excess — is carried by the gps_trace alone. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the judge's confidence cannot exceed the weight of the artifact that carries the deciding fact, and where two or more independent artifacts carry it the cap is the maximum of their weights; here there is no second independent artifact, so the ceiling is 0.6 (EV-GPS-04003, issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW). A ceiling of 0.6 sits below the platform-wide floor of 0.70, which is itself a mandatory escalation trigger, and bundle_integrity is context only rather than the cap.

If the judge nonetheless reaches the merits, the deviation is not a MATERIAL one even taken at face value on the impaired trace (EV-GPS-04003, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, weight 0.6). The excess is 4.1 km, or 30.37% of the 13.5 km optimal route — above the POL-RD-01 establishment gates of 0.8 km and 20%, but well below its materiality gates of 8.0 km and 50%. POL-RD-06's pattern check and conduct referral are therefore not in play, and on the driver's own numbers there is no pattern to find in any event: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 245, a ratio of 0.00 where the clause requires 0.05 or more with at least 40 trips. No uplift of any refund and no referral to driver-conduct review is available on this record, and no lifetime counter such as prior_deviation_flags may be substituted for the trailing-90-day figure POL-RD-06 names.

ledger.claim: Also on the merits, the sum the rider asks for is not the sum the policy arithmetic produces. Under POL-RD-02 the recomputed fare is (3.80 + 0.75 x 13.5 + 0.28 x 20) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee = 20.325, so the refund is 25.08 - 20.325 = 4.755, rounded up to 4.80 — 18.96% of the charged total, nowhere near the 90% that would convert it into a FULL_REFUND, and above the 0.50 de minimis floor. The rider's recollections of 'about 19' for a usual fare and '6.00' for the difference are round numbers not carried by the ledger, which reconciles to the cent at distance_charged_km 17.60 at 0.75 and time_charged_min 26 at 0.28.

There is no pass-through correction to add on top of anything. The fare breakdown carries no ERP or toll lines at all (total 0.00), no airport surcharge, no waiting-time fee and no promo discount, so POL-RD-09 offers the rider no standalone correction and no billing-integrity finding is available; and in any event any off-route ERP element is already comprehended in the POL-RD-02 figure and must never be added on top of it.

The only traffic-advisory artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-04003-01, is MISSING: its payload is null and its weight_multiplier is 0.0, the identifier having been minted so that the absence itself could be cited. Under POL-RD-13 that absence is a gap in the bundle and not a contradiction within it: no advisory covers this corridor, so no closure-based exoneration under POL-RD-03 is available and none is asserted on the driver's behalf, and equally the absence supplies nothing that could corroborate the impaired trace under POL-RD-07(ii). The case therefore turns on EV-GPS-04003 alone, and EV-GPS-04003 is impaired.
